newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela business confidence tepid, but improving.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela business confidence tepid, but improving.

text.p: Venezuelan business confidence may only be lukewarm but it is improving, a survey by local business chamber Coindustria showed.

According to the fourth quarter of 1996 survey, which polled 450 large, medium and small businesses, the general perception "is moving from one of average to bad' to one of average to good'," Coindustria president Pedro Carmona told reporters.
On a scale of one to six, where six is a measure of high private sector confidence, the survey's index reached 3.35, Carmona said.

The poll also revealed that 54 percent of businesses said they would not lay-off workers, compared to 49 percent in the third quarter. Falling idle capacity also showed a pick-up in demand, Carmona said, although he added that may reflect seasonal factors.
